summary:
IPSEITY's social layer is one adminless contract, Parley (src/Parley.sol, 6,379 B runtime), that stores almost nothing: every message is a Said log and the contract keeps per room only the block of the newest message and a counter. Each log carries the block of the previous message in the room (prev) and by the same token (prevFrom), so any client with a public RPC reads a conversation backwards with single-block eth_getLogs calls and never a range scan or an indexer (measured: 405 blocks of history in 3 queries). Three room kinds: the commons (key 0, every token), steward-founded groups (key keccak(1,index)), and pair rooms derived from two ids (keccak(2,min,max)) that exist on first use and are refused through the generic speak path. Who may speak as token N is ownerOf(N) or N's ERC-6551 Reach account, never the ERC-4907 renter. Invitations record permission; joining is the token's own transaction, so the only unbounded array can be grown only by its owner. Tokens publish P-256 points (announce) bound to the publishing owner so a transfer silently retires the key; DeskSeal derives the private scalar from a personal_sign signature and seals pair messages with static-static ECDH + AES-256-GCM in WebCrypto. Roster (3,267 B) is a stateless read companion that enumerates group membership 256 tokens per word without touching the archive.

ParleyPort (4,246 B) is a hand-declared LayerZero V2 OApp receiver with no admin: setDelegate(0) in the constructor, DVN/library pin passed as constructor arguments and never writable again, only the commons crosses, it cannot write into Parley (arrivals are emitted under its own Echoed event with the back-link rewritten into the receiving chain's block numbers), it checks the body's claimed origin eid against the DVN-attested envelope, and delivery is permissionless. It was found speaking its mock's dialect (wrong lzReceive selector, missing allowInitializePath/nextNonce) by probing real selectors at deployed bytecode, fixed, and then proven live: deployed from a nonce-0 key at the same address 0x65d1e9d0…c7ae on Base Sepolia and Ethereum Sepolia, one echo quoted at 104,037,152,596,558 wei, 323,518 gas, delivered by real DVNs in ~80 s into block 45,828,666 and walked back in one query. OMNICHAIN.md is the research record refusing ONFT for a 6551-based token (metadata cannot travel, account addresses commit to chain id, id bands are the supply guarantee, a delegate is an admin key). The edition was later made Ethereum-only (fe990f7), so the port survives only as an optional speech satellite, and on the default branch no client renders Echoed (an unmerged branch adds that to the console).

Nameplate (9,957 B) is an adminless ENS resolver: a name means a token either by explicit bind (ENS owner who also holds the token or is its Reach) or, outranking that, by custody of the wrapped name NFT inside the token's 6551 account, verified three ways (registry owner is the canonical NameWrapper, wrapper ownerOf is a contract whose token() names this hub, and that address equals hub.account(id) or hub.grip(id)). addr is the Reach, text("contentcontract") is the Premises in ERC-3770 form per ERC-6821 so web3://name.eth/chat opens the chain-served site, avatar is a CAIP erc721 reference, numeric subdomains of a write-once parent resolve by ENSIP-10 wildcard, expiry is read from the registrar the registry names, and renewal is write-once-configured and offered to anyone. The multi-chain station table inside it is vestigial after Ethereum-only.

The website is delivered entirely from chain: Premises.request (ERC-5219) returns HTML assembled by page contracts, with the JavaScript client, CSS and a JSON config block (addresses, the Said topic from Parley.topics(), and every selector hashed on chain) held as Solidity string constants; the browser ships no keccak and no ABI coder. Reading is never gated; writing is gated by the client reading balanceOf/tokenOfOwnerByIndex off the hub to pick a 'speaking as' token, and decisively by Parley.mayActAs reverting NotYours for any sender that is not the owner or the token's Reach. Everything is tested three ways: 26 Foundry tests, independent in-process walkers (verify-parley 37, verify-port 42, verify-plate ~73), and the shipped client driven in a DOM shim (verify-site 586).

components.name: Parley
components.purpose: Token-to-token messaging as event logs: commons (room 0), steward-founded groups, derived pair rooms; per-room head + back-links so the archive is walkable with single-block eth_getLogs and no indexer; per-token P-256 sealing points.
key_functions: mayActAs(uint256 token, address who) view returns (bool)
speak(uint256 room, uint256 from, uint8 kind, bytes body)
whisper(uint256 from, uint256 to, uint8 kind, bytes body)
found(uint256 by, string name, bool openDoor) returns (uint256 key)
invite(uint256 room, uint256 by, uint256 token) / join(room, token) / leave(room, token) / evict(room, by, token)
announce(uint256 token, bytes32 x, bytes32 y) / keyOf / sealX / sealY / keysOf
stateOf(uint256 room) returns (last,count,opened,members,kind,open,steward,index,name)
heads(uint256[] rooms) returns (last[], count[])
roomsOf(uint256 token) returns (keys[], member[]) / roomCount
groupKey(uint256 index) pure / pairKey(uint256 a, uint256 b) pure
topics() pure returns the five event topic0s
design_decisions: Message = log; room stores only (last block, count); Said carries prev and prevFrom so clients walk backwards one block at a time — 'the chain is the index' (Parley.sol:28–43)
Speaker = ownerOf or the token's ERC-6551 Reach, never the ERC-4907 renter: 'a reputation is not a thing you can hand back at the end of the day' (45–52)
Pair rooms are derived from ids and refused through speak (UseWhisper) so membership is never stored (212–215)
invite records permission, join is the token's own call: 'an array a stranger can grow is an array a stranger can fill' (106–111)
Sealing points are bound to the publishing owner; a transfer makes them read as absent (4fa41d0)
topics() hashes the event signatures on chain so the browser ships no keccak (441–444)
No delete, no edit, no moderation beyond steward invite/evict; eviction cannot unsay anything
security_invariants: Every write passes mayActAs(token, msg.sender) (INVARIANTS 79)
Walk always goes backwards; follow the oldest log in a block (INV 80–81)
Group and pair keys never collide; pair key refused via speak (INV 82–83)
Only the token can lengthen its own room list (INV 85)
Body 1..1024 bytes, kind in {0,1} (INV 88)
Sealing key reads as zero once the publisher no longer owns the token (INV 112)
components.reuse_notes: Near-verbatim: rebind ISpeaker to the new hub (ownerOf, account). Consider a reply pointer, group sealing, and spam limits on the commons. Keep the back-link mechanism and topics() exactly.

components.name: Roster
components.purpose: Stateless read-only companion enumerating group membership, pending invitations and stewarded rooms as 256-bit windows over public Parley state, so no event replay or indexer is needed.
key_functions: kindOf(uint256 room) returns 0 commons / 1 group / 2 pair / 3 NO_ROOM
inWindow(uint256 room, uint256 from) returns (uint256 bits)
invitedInWindow(uint256 room, uint256 from) returns (uint256 bits)
membersOf(uint256 room, uint256 from) returns (uint256[] ids)
stewardedBy(uint256 token, uint256 fromIndex, uint256 count) returns (keys[], indexes[])
heldBy(uint256 token) returns (address)
design_decisions: Separate contract so the archive (Parley) is never redeployed to answer a read question (Roster.sol:38–45)
Commons membership is answered true for every minted token because Parley never writes inRoom for room 0 (INV 114)
NO_ROOM = 3 disambiguates Parley's kind-0-for-unfounded from the commons
~550k gas of eth_call per 256-token window, free to the reader
security_invariants: No storage, no writes
Windows skip id 0 and id > totalSupply
components.reuse_notes: Assumes contiguous ids from 1 and a hub with totalSupply/ownerOf; parametrise if the unified id scheme differs.

components.name: ParleyPort
components.purpose: LayerZero V2 OApp that echoes commons (room 0) messages to peer chains and emits arrivals under its own Echoed event with a locally rewritten back-link; no admin, no delegate, peers and DVN pin fixed at construction.
key_functions: constructor(IParleyRead parley, ILayerZeroEndpointV2 endpoint, uint32[] peerEids, bytes32[] peers, LanePin[] lanePins, ConfigPin[] configPins)
quoteEcho(uint256 from, uint8 kind, bytes body, bytes options) view returns (uint256 total)
echo(uint256 from, uint8 kind, bytes body, bytes options) payable
lzReceive(Origin origin, bytes32 guid, bytes message, address executor, bytes extraData) payable — selector 0x13137d65
allowInitializePath(Origin) view returns (bool) — 0xff7bd03d
nextNonce(uint32, bytes32) pure returns (0) — 0x7d25a05e
peers() / peerOf(uint32) / lastEcho() / echoCount()
design_decisions: Local first: Parley.speak is untouched and federation is a separate payable call (ParleyPort.sol:43–53)
Only the commons crosses: groups carry a steward (authority), pairs are derived from ids that may live on different chains (59–65)
Cannot write into Parley; arrivals are a second archive tagged with origin eid (67–74)
Back-link rewritten into the receiving chain's block numbering (80–84)
setDelegate(0) at construction; pin passed as constructor args; floating on defaults is a stated choice admissible for speech, not custody (96–113)
Empty options become a 22-byte type-3 default naming 200,000 gas because ULN302 refuses empty options (146–160)
Body's claimed origin eid must equal the DVN-attested envelope (374–378)
Overpayment refunded; no hidden revenue (295–301)
Deployed from a nonce-0 key so CREATE lands at the same address on every chain and each port names its own address as its peer
security_invariants: No function can set delegate, config, send/receive library or peers after construction (INV 138)
Only ENDPOINT may call lzReceive; origin must be a built peer; body eid must match envelope (INV 143)
Only room 0 crosses; no group/pair/whisper function exists (INV 136)
Parley has no knowledge of the port (INV 137)
Canonical protocol selectors asserted byte-for-byte (INV 141)
components.reuse_notes: Keep only if the unified protocol federates speech across chains; otherwise drop and keep OMNICHAIN.md as the ONFT-refusal record. On HEAD no client renders Echoed; the Sepolia port's immutable PARLEY is stale relative to the redeployed site.

components.name: Nameplate
components.purpose: Adminless ENS resolver: a name means a token by custody of the wrapped name NFT in the token's 6551 account (outranks bind) or by explicit bind; addr = the Reach; text(contentcontract) = the Premises per ERC-6821; avatar = CAIP NFT ref; ENSIP-10 numeric wildcard under a write-once parent; expiry/renewal reads.
key_functions: bind(bytes32 node, uint256 token) / unbind(node) / bindByName(bytes name, uint256) / unbindByName / nodeOf(bytes)
claimParent(bytes32) / claimParentByName(bytes) — write-once by the ENS owner
setStation(uint256 chainId, address premises, address hub) — vestigial after Ethereum-only
setRenewer(address) — write-once by the parent's owner; renewPrice(string,uint256); expiry(string); nameStatus(string,uint256); registrar()
heldBy(bytes32 node) returns (uint256 token, bool sealed)
addr(bytes32) / contenthash(bytes32) (empty) / text(bytes32,string) / resolve(bytes,bytes) / tokenForName(bytes) / whereIs(uint256) / supportsInterface
design_decisions: Custody is the binding and outranks bind because a recorded intention can go stale (60–67)
An account's own token() is disbelieved unless the registry owner is the canonical NameWrapper and the hub derives that same address (79–83, b43645e)
contentcontract is ERC-3770 shortName:address, not CAIP eip155 (465–479, 6055f32)
Unservable numeric wildcard answers empty, never the parent's record (567–575)
Registrar derived from ENS.owner(namehash('eth')); grace asked, not assumed; unknown is zeros not lapsed (276–320)
Renewer address is told, write-once, because nothing on chain names the current controller (322–345)
*ByName variants take DNS wire format so the browser hashes nothing (214–217)
Deploys on chains with no ENS so the address matches everywhere; every bind refuses NoRegistryHere
security_invariants: bind requires ENS/NameWrapper ownership of the node AND holder-or-Reach of the token
parentNode, stationOf[chain], renewer are write-once
heldBy returns (0,false) for impostor accounts, other collections, wallets, unwrapped controllers, non-canonical wrappers
components.reuse_notes: Keep custody-as-binding, ERC-6821 record, numeric wildcard, registrar-derived expiry, write-once renewer, DNS-wire variants. Strip station/gateway/short-name tables; take the unmerged Sepolia NameWrapper fix (adedb26).

components.name: DeskTalk (+ PageTalk, PageRooms, DeskRooms)
components.purpose: The chat client as Solidity string constants plus an on-chain-built JSON config (addresses, Said topic, 23 selectors); PageTalk renders /chat and /dm/<id>, PageRooms renders /rooms and /room/<n>, DeskRooms adds invite/evict/roster words to the terminal.
key_functions: DeskTalk.config(uint256 room, uint256 other, uint256 group) view returns (string)
DeskTalk.core() / rooms() / door() pure returns <script> blocks
PageTalk.chat() / dm(uint256 other)
PageRooms.rooms() / room(uint256 index)
client: held(addr) via balanceOf+tokenOfOwnerByIndex (≤64), back(room,want) single-block walk, send() builds speak/whisper calldata, watch() polls heads() every 9 s
design_decisions: No keccak in the page; topics and selectors arrive computed on chain (DeskTalk.sol:18–21)
No innerHTML for anything off the chain; textContent only, on the same origin as the wallet-injected instrument (23–28)
No range scans; one block per eth_getLogs (30–33)
Reading is never gated; the gate hides a composer, not a fact (PageTalk.sol:97–113)
Holding nothing renders as information, not failure
security_invariants: Zero state-changing functions in page/desk ABIs (INV 92)
Hostile body round-trips as text (INV 90)
Every eth_getLogs has fromBlock == toBlock (INV 81)
components.reuse_notes: Reuse the three refusals and the config-block pattern; redesign the chrome; merge with the console surface. Sizes: DeskTalk 20,422 B, PageTalk 10,193 B, PageRooms 9,008 B, DeskRooms 2,106 B.

components.name: DeskSeal
components.purpose: Client half of sealed DMs: derive a P-256 scalar from personal_sign over 'IPSEITY seal v1 · chain · token', import as PKCS#8 so WebCrypto computes the point, publish via announce, static-static ECDH → SHA-256 → AES-256-GCM; arms only when both tokens' current holders have published.
key_functions: derive(tok)
onChain(tok) via keyOf
pairKey(mine, theirs)
seal(h) → {k:1, iv||ct}
window.UNSEAL(m, p)
arm(me)
design_decisions: Key derived, not stored — same key in every browser, nothing to back up, but no forward secrecy and rotation orphans old ciphertext (DeskSeal.sol:15–34)
Own key checked before the peer's so a stale key is reported even with nobody to talk to (INV 113)
Banner claims only what the chain proves: both points belong to current holders (INV 112)
security_invariants: Sealed rows render as sealed, never mojibake
Decrypted text reaches the DOM via textContent
standards: RFC 6979 deterministic signatures (assumed of the wallet)
components.reuse_notes: Take the unmerged per-send peer-key revalidation (7f58e37). Flag: a signature over a fixed sentence is phishable by any dapp that requests the same personal_sign; consider a domain-bound EIP-712 derivation or ephemeral per-message keys (HPKE).

components.name: PageName
components.purpose: The /name page: builds DNS wire format by string arithmetic, previews what a name means (tokenForName/tokenOf/addr/text/ENS.owner), binds/unbinds, claims the wildcard parent once, shows the expiry clock and a permissionless renewal.
key_functions: namePage() view returns (string)
client: wire(name), nodeFor(h), look(), tokl(), renew via renewer.renew(string,uint256) at price*105/100
design_decisions: Unicode names refused rather than ENSIP-15 approximated
Parent claim kept in its own card because it is irreversible
No-registry chains get prose and no controls
Expiry card independent of the parent-claim card (afc5d55)
security_invariants: Resolver-controlled strings escaped before innerHTML (ESC)
components.reuse_notes: 21,567 B (87.8%); near the ceiling. Convert the innerHTML boundary to textContent for consistency.

components.name: PageManifest parley block + Premises routes
components.purpose: /services.json publishes Parley address, commons key, groups, maxBody, the Said topic, the speak selector and the walk rule — 'the instruction manual for replacing the browser'; Premises routes /chat, /rooms, /room/<n>, /dm/<id>, /name.
key_functions: PageManifest._parley() view
Premises.request(string[] resource, KeyValue[] params) view returns (uint16, string, KeyValue[])
design_decisions: A program holding contract+topic+walk can read the archive without the site (PageManifest.sol:417–424)
Pages are immutable constructor args of Premises; adding a page means a new Premises
security_invariants: Manifest topic equals keccak of the Said signature (verify-site)
components.reuse_notes: The manifest shape is directly reusable for agent/program access to the messaging layer.

components.name: tools/port.mjs
components.purpose: Deploy and drive ParleyPort on real chains: status (measure endpoint, eid, nonce), deploy (nonce-0 same-address mesh, hand-encoded six-arg constructor, read-back with patient retries), quote/echo, walk (single-block Echoed walk).
key_functions: status
deploy --peers a,b [--lane-lib eid:send:recv] [--config-pin lib:eid:type:0x..] [--dry] [--nonce N]
quote/echo --port --from --text
walk --port
design_decisions: Fresh nonce-0 key so CREATE address is identical everywhere and peers are self-referential (port.mjs:12–22)
Reads after deploy retried because load-balanced RPCs answer 0x from a lagging replica (186–199)
PRIVATE_KEY required for writes; never signs with dev keys (f56c66b)
security_invariants: Landed address must equal prediction or abort
components.reuse_notes: Generalises to any multi-chain satellite that must know its peers at construction.

components.name: tools/ens-name.mjs
components.purpose: ENS commit-reveal registration pointing a name's resolver and addr at the Premises; Sepolia tables; random persisted secret; refuses the already-public label.
key_functions: makeCommitment/register((string,address,uint256,bytes32,address,bytes[],uint8,bytes32))
setAddr(bytes32,address)
design_decisions: Controller address and ABI taken from ensdomains deployments, not docs, after two silent failures (46–54)
Secret persisted at mode 0600 so a retry reveals the same commitment (e9e1224)
security_invariants: Chain must be 11155111; every address must have code
components.reuse_notes: Needs a mainnet table; Sepolia cannot register a 2LD at all (BaseRegistrar.controllers(NameWrapper)==0).

components.name: Verification suite for the area
components.purpose: verify-parley (37): independent walker counting queries and watching the naive walker loop; verify-port (42): protocol selectors, pin, lane truth table, refusal on both sides of the border; verify-plate (~73): custody, counterfeit, expiry, renewal, rehearsal chain; verify-site (586): the shipped client driven in a DOM shim incl. sealed DMs and the roster; test/Parley.t.sol (26); MockEndpoint performs the real handshake; probe-port-abi.mjs drives raw selectors at deployed bytecode.
key_functions: walk(room) in verify-parley
inject/deliver/deliverUnchecked in MockEndpoint
fixture(chainId) in verify-plate
design_decisions: Two independent readers of one archive must agree
A mock must use the compiler's selectors (abi.encodeCall), never a private dialect
Dispatch proven by reaching a named refusal, never by success
components.reuse_notes: Port the assertions as the acceptance tests for the unified messaging layer.

components.name: OMNICHAIN.md
components.purpose: Research record: LayerZero V2 read from source, measured endpoint table, why ONFT/OFT are refused for a 6551-based token, what was found broken in the port and fixed, the live federation run, and what remains.
design_decisions: Tokens never bridge: metadata cannot travel, 6551 addresses commit to chain id, id bands are the supply guarantee, ONFT's delegate is an admin key (§3)
lzRead measured 17x cheaper than messaging and not adopted until needed
components.reuse_notes: Use as the decision record for the unified protocol's cross-chain stance.

standards_implemented: ERC-5219 (Premises request) serving the chat/name pages
ERC-6821 contentcontract text record (ERC-3770 chain-specific address form)
ERC-137 addr(bytes32), ERC-634 text(bytes32,string), ERC-1577 contenthash (deliberately empty)
ENSIP-10 wildcard resolve(bytes,bytes) with numeric-label parsing; ENSIP-12 avatar as eip155/erc721 CAIP reference
ERC-6551 account()/grip() derivation and token() custody check
ERC-4907 userOf — renter explicitly excluded from speaking
LayerZero V2 ILayerZeroReceiver: lzReceive((uint32,bytes32,uint64),bytes32,bytes,address,bytes) 0x13137d65, allowInitializePath 0xff7bd03d, nextNonce 0x7d25a05e; type-3 executor options
EIP-6963 wallet discovery in the chrome
WebCrypto P-256 ECDH + AES-256-GCM + PKCS#8 for sealed DMs; personal_sign-derived keys (RFC 6979 assumed)
unique_ideas: Indexer-free chat: every Said log carries prev (room) and prevFrom (token) block pointers; the room stores only the head block and a count; clients walk with single-block eth_getLogs (405 blocks in 3 queries) and must follow the oldest log in a block to terminate
The contract serves its own event topics (Parley.topics()) and every selector is hashed on chain into the page's config JSON so the browser carries no keccak and no ABI coder
Pair rooms derived as keccak(2,min,max): exist on first whisper, unreachable via speak (UseWhisper), no membership storage
Invitations record permission; joining is the token's own transaction, so the only unbounded array is grown only by its owner
Sealing keys bound to the publishing owner: a transfer silently retires the old key so nobody seals to a departed holder; key derived from a wallet signature so there is nothing to store
Roster: 256 memberships per word via eth_call windows; NO_ROOM=3 disambiguates kind 0; stewarded rooms derived from counters, no event replay

Speech-only LayerZero federation: no delegate ever, DVN/library pin as constructor args, only room 0 crosses, arrivals emitted under the port's own Echoed with the back-link rewritten into local block numbers, body-vs-envelope origin check, permissionless delivery, default 22-byte options blob
Nonce-0 CREATE from a fresh key puts the port at the same address on every chain, so each port names its own address as its peer and the mesh closes with no second pass

Custody is the binding: an ENS name NFT inside the token's 6551 account IS the record, cross-checked registry→canonical wrapper→account.token()→hub-derived address; sell the token and the name goes with it; in the Grip it is permanent

ERC-6821 contentcontract so web3://name.eth/chat opens the chain-served site; ENSIP-10 numeric wildcard gives every token a name at mint; expiry derived from ENS.owner(namehash('eth')); renewal offered to anyone with a write-once renewer
services.json as 'the instruction manual for replacing the browser': address, topic, selector, walk rule
Test the wire not the mirror: probe real protocol selectors at deployed bytecode; mocks built with abi.encodeCall; a second independent reader of every archive
weaknesses: Commons has no spam control beyond gas and no pagination beyond walking; MAX_BODY 1,024 with no multi-part convention; no reply/thread pointer, no reactions
Groups are public to read; only pair rooms can be sealed; DeskSeal has no forward secrecy (static-static ECDH, one key per pair)
Seal private key is SHA-256 of a personal_sign over a fixed sentence — any dapp that obtains that signature derives the DM key (phishing surface)
On HEAD, DeskSeal arms once per page; a transfer mid-session is only handled by the unmerged fix 7f58e37 (re-read peer key before every send)
announce accepts any 64 bytes (no on-curve check)
ParleyPort floats on default DVNs unless pinned; mainnet lanes undeployed; quoteEcho/echo are all-or-nothing across peers; failed refund reverts with the misleading Underpaid(spent)
Live Ethereum Sepolia port is wired to a stale Parley (port-11155111.json parley 0x5973a4d1… vs eth-sepolia.json parley 0x99f5d809…) after the site was redeployed under it
No client on the default branch renders Echoed; the console SPEAK lane is 'unbuilt' on HEAD (federated lane exists only on branch claude/claude-md-docs-8vvyc8)
Nameplate's station/whereIs/short-name/gateway tables are vestigial after Ethereum-only and bake w3link hostnames into immutable bytecode
tools/site.mjs gives Ethereum Sepolia the mainnet NameWrapper address; the one-line fix (adedb26, PR #26) is not on HEAD, so wrapped-name custody is never recognised on Sepolia deployments
heldBy needs an embodied (code-bearing) 6551 account; counterfactual accounts resolve to nothing
No ENSIP-9 multi-coin addr, no reverse name(), no ENSIP-15 normalisation (page refuses non-ASCII), text answers only four keys; bind cannot verify the name's resolver points here
PageName renders resolver-controlled text through innerHTML with an escape helper — the one departure from the textContent rule
Roster assumes ids 1..totalSupply contiguous; DeskTalk's held() caps at 64 tokens per wallet
Docs drift: DEPLOYMENTS.md 'Live now' lags deployments/*.json; README size table omits ParleyPort/Roster/Nameplate; verify-plate count not re-measured after fe990f7
ENS 2LD registration impossible on Sepolia; tools/ens-name.mjs has Sepolia-only tables; no mainnet name exists yet
website_delivery: Entirely from chain. Premises.request (ERC-5219, src/Premises.sol:250) dispatches /chat, /rooms, /room/<n>, /dm/<id>, /name to PageTalk/PageRooms/PageName, whose bodies are string.concat of Chrome (CSS/nav), an on-chain-built JSON config (DeskTalk.config: Parley/Roster/hub addresses, room key, steward, MAX_BODY, the Said topic from Parley.topics(), 23 selectors hashed on chain), and the JavaScript client held as Solidity string constants (DeskTalk.TALK_JS/DOOR_JS/ROOMS_JS, DeskSeal.SEAL_JS, Chrome.WALLET_JS, Desk.core). Reachable natively over web3://<premises>:<chain>/chat (ERC-4804/6860), via public ERC-5219 gateways (https://<premises>.sep.w3link.io/…), or via tools/gateway.mjs where every GET is an eth_call. /services.json publishes the Parley address, commons key, Said topic, speak selector and the walk rule for programs. No static site, no bundler, no IPFS, no server; the browser ships no keccak and no ABI coder. Live records: deployments/base-sepolia.json (premises 0xc59f75d2…3161) and deployments/eth-sepolia.json (premises 0x7e1bdcd8…7a31).
wallet_gating: Reading is never gated ('the gate hides a composer, not a fact'). Writing: the client discovers a provider via EIP-6963, calls eth_requestAccounts, reads balanceOf(addr) and walks tokenOfOwnerByIndex(addr,i) (≤64) on the hub to list held tokens into a 'speaking as' select (DeskTalk.sol:159–163, 269–276), remembers the choice in localStorage, and for a DM derives the pair room from pairKey(me, other). That is UX only. The authoritative check is on chain: every Parley write calls mayActAs(token, msg.sender) = msg.sender == HUB.ownerOf(token) || msg.sender == HUB.account(token) (the ERC-6551 Reach, so session keys acting through it count) and reverts NotYours otherwise; the ERC-4907 renter is explicitly refused. ParleyPort.echo delegates to the same mayActAs. Nameplate.bind additionally requires ENS registry/NameWrapper ownership of the node. Sealed DMs require both tokens' current holders to have published P-256 points (keys read as zero after a transfer). No signature challenge, no session cookie, no server: the signed transaction is the proof and the EVM is the verifier.

pitfalls: A mock written to match the contract certifies a dialect: lzReceive(Origin,…) is 0x13137d65 with Origin a static tuple; allowInitializePath/nextNonce must exist or no lane initialises — probe real selectors at deployed bytecode
ULN302 refuses empty options at quote time (Executor_NoOptions); 'no options' must mean a type-3 default naming lzReceive gas
LayerZero eids are not chain ids; the registry lists a dead legacy Sepolia eid 30161 — wire 40161; four distinct canonical endpoint addresses exist
nameExpires takes keccak(label), not namehash(name); mixing them returns a confident zero
ERC-6821 contentcontract must be a bare address or ERC-3770 shortName:0x…, never CAIP eip155:…; eip155 IS right for the avatar record
w3link hostnames need the chain short name (<addr>.eth.w3link.io); <addr>.w3link.io does not resolve

ENS Sepolia cannot register a .eth 2LD (controllers(NameWrapper)=0) and reverts bare after the commitment is paid; the controller register() ABI is now a struct with uint8 reverseRecord and bytes32 referrer
ERC-6551 accounts are counterfactual until embodied; custody checks calling token() see nothing at a codeless address
Two messages in one block: the second's prev is its own block — follow the oldest log's pointer or loop forever
block.number captured before vm.roll in a test is sunk by the optimiser to after it; read evidence from storage
Load-balanced public RPCs answer 0x from a lagging replica after a deploy — treat empty as 'not yet' and retry
Room kind 0 means both 'the commons' and 'never founded'; Parley never writes inRoom for the commons
The test harness's bytes encoder must be given hex; a Buffer once encoded as empty and framed a correct contract as buggy
Nonce-0 same-address mesh deploy needs a fresh key on every chain; the tool refuses otherwise
DeskTerm sits at 97% of EIP-170 — new terminal words go in satellite contracts registering through def
A site redeploy must keep the Parley address (every message is a log that contract emitted) — and any satellite (port, PageConsole) holding it as an immutable goes stale when it is not kept
tests_and_tooling: Foundry-shaped suite run without Foundry (tools/forge.mjs): test/Parley.t.sol has 26 statement-named tests (e.g. test_theBoundAccountMaySpeakAndTheRenterMayNot, test_aPairRoomCannotBePostedToThroughSpeak, test_nobodyCanLengthenSomebodyElsesRoomList, test_transferInvalidatesTheFormerHoldersSealingKey, test_theTopicsAreDerivedFromTheSignaturesThemselves). In-process EVM verifiers on @ethereumjs/vm: tools/verify-parley.mjs (37 assertions; a second independent walker that counts queries and runs the naive walker to watch it loop), tools/verify-port.mjs (42; canonical selectors byte-for-byte, lane truth table, constructor pin, refusal on both sides of the border, stranger delivery, back-link rewrite, Parley ignorant of the port), tools/verify-plate.mjs (~73 before the Ethereum-only cut; custody beats stale bind, impostor/other-collection/wallet/unwrapped/non-canonical-wrapper all disbelieved, registrar-derived expiry, label-vs-namehash, permissionless renewal, rehearsal chain via Chain.open({chainId})), tools/verify-site.mjs (586; drives the shipped DeskTalk/DeskSeal/PageName clients in a DOM shim: hostile body stays text, every eth_getLogs is single-block, pair room derived client-side, sealed DM round trip with an eavesdropper reading bytes, sale invalidates the key, roster bitmaps, nameplate page binds/unbinds/renews). Mocks: MockEndpoint (real allowInitializePath handshake, abi.encodeCall delivery, refuses options < 2 bytes, inject/deliver/deliverUnchecked), MockENS, MockRegistrar/DumbRegistrar/MockController, MockHub, MockAccount/MockWrapper, LzStub. Probes: probe-port-abi.mjs (raw selectors at deployed bytecode), probe-lz/uln/dvn/ccip2/bridges.mjs (live chain measurements behind OMNICHAIN.md). Live tooling: tools/port.mjs (status/deploy/quote/echo/walk), tools/ens-name.mjs, tools/testnet.mjs (seeds and walks a conversation over a real node), tools/gas.mjs (chat routes measured as the cheapest pages). All of verify-parley, verify-port, verify-plate, verify-site are inside npm run check (26 steps).
